responsibility: Implements the Modula-2 Args library on top of the lower-level UnixArgs support, providing the runtime bridge from process argv storage to Modula-2 fixed-size string buffers. It exposes routines to count arguments and copy the nth argument into a caller-supplied array, translating the C argv representation into the GNU Modula-2 calling convention while using ASCII_nul termination semantics.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of Args: it actually fetches argc/argv data through UnixArgs_GetArgC/GetArgV and copies characters into caller buffers with ASCII_nul termination. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GArgs.h, it contains the executable bridge to the UnixArgs runtime rather than just the API declarations.
